decision: NX-033 §4.1 (D1–D5 settled): the stages the trusted controller runs for one SHA in a fresh checkout. The controller and this policy come from the trusted installation (main as released), never from the candidate. scripts/ci/check stays the authoritative suite and is run whole as the 'suite' stage; splitting it into admission … pi-runtime stages is left to a later version of this file. The dependency stages are the only ones with network, through the allowlisted proxy (egress.v1.json); every later stage runs offline from the warm cache (UV_OFFLINE, npm offline) with loopback only. A cache miss without network fails the build as dependency_unavailable, never a skipped test (§6). The isolation probe uses the trusted controller copy and the private targets file mounted read-only.
